days_pending.definition: Median days from first listing to pending status.
days_pending.label: Median days to pending

inventory.definition: Unique listings active at any time during the month.
inventory.label: For-sale inventory

price_cut_share.definition: Share of active listings with a price reduction during the month.
price_cut_share.label: Listings with a price cut

sale_to_list.definition: Mean sale price divided by the final list price.
sale_to_list.label: Mean sale-to-list ratio

zhvi.definition: Zillow Home Value Index for the typical mid-tier home.
zhvi.label: Typical home value

zori.definition: Zillow Observed Rent Index for all homes and multifamily rentals.
zori.label: Typical observed rent
